description: For every countable set \(S\) of ordinals below \(\omega_1\), the supremum of the successors of its members is below \(\omega_1\) and strictly above every member of \(S\). For the empty set this supremum is zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.countable_ordinals_bounded.{u} (S : Set Ordinal.{u}) (hS : S.Countable)
  (hbound : ∀ a ∈ S, a < Ordinal.omega 1) : ⨆ a, ↑a + 1 < Ordinal.omega 1 ∧ ∀ a ∈ S, a < ⨆ b, ↑b + 1
